t: Here in Portland Place is the equestrian statue of Field Marshal Sir George Stuart White, a Grade Two listed bronze by the sculptor John Tweed, unveiled in 1922. White won the Victoria Cross for his bravery at the battles of Charasiab in 1879 and Kandahar in 1880, during the Second Anglo-Afghan War. He later commanded forces in Natal at the opening of the Second Boer War, and fought at the Battle of Elandslaagte in October 1899.
